title: The operator's mandate a task carries down a chain of agents (mandate/1, DEC-0125)
description: The operator's instruction for one task, carried by the agent leading it and handed on, narrowed, to the agents it engages (docs/specification/delegation.md#the-operators-mandate). It travels in a request's _meta.mandate, a hub agent.call's or a sealed call's call.mandate, or a project-board request's body. A callee takes a call it covers from a T0 or T1 caller as the operator's decision (MD-3); across the machine boundary it grants nothing (MD-5). mandateCovers in src/mandate.ts is the reference; FAC-SEM-144 checks the document.

task.description: The task the operator gave, as the leading agent names it (a board task id, a backlog row, a title); the executor records it with the operator's words.

instruction.description: The operator's words that gave the task, verbatim, in AP-3's form: their sentence, or the agent's question and their answer.

expiresAt.description: When the mandate ends: after at and at most 7 days after it (FAC-SEM-144).

scope.description: What the operator's words cover, as the leading agent states it from them; every hand-over narrows it (MD-2).

chain.description: The agents the mandate passed through, the leading agent first: each hand-over appends the agent handing on and, when it narrows, the narrower scope. At most four, as a delegation chain (DL-6).

agent.description: The agent that held the mandate at this step.

at.description: When it took or handed it on.

scope.description: The narrower scope it handed on; absent, it handed on what it held.

capabilities.description: The capabilities (tool names) the task may call; absent, any capability whose effect is within effects.

actions.description: The relayed actions (extensions/actions/0.1 ids) the task may take as the operator's decision; absent, a relayed action is covered only through a listed capability that is its tool.

effects.description: The effect ceiling, read as a grant's effectCeiling is (none below every class, draft below every external effect).

spendUsd.description: The most the task may spend in USD from this point of the chain; absent, nothing. A call whose own estimate exceeds it is outside the mandate. The money limits (L0, L1, each key's ceiling) bind besides.

projects.description: The projects the task may act in, by id or slug; absent, any of the operator's.
